findings.issue: Distractor D 'Cysteine and iron' half-overlaps the right answer: nutritionally variant streptococci are supported by pyridoxal OR L-cysteine, so a prepared candidate may hesitate. Key B (pyridoxal) is correct and D is wrong because of 'iron', but the distractor is closer than it needs to be.
findings.fix: Replace D with a clearly wrong requirement, e.g. 'Hemin and NAD together' or 'Thiamine (vitamin B1)'.

findings.issue: Stored correctAnswer letters rotate A, B, C, D in strict ID order across all 200 items. Harmless on screen because options are shuffled every showing and check_answer_patterns looks at words, not letters, but anyone reading the JSON in ID order can predict every key.
findings.fix: Optional: let build.py place keys by a stem-seeded shuffle instead of i % 4.
